details:
- Rebuild el9_6 against golang >= 1.25.7-1.el9_6.tuxcare.els21 and el9_2 against
  golang >= 1.22.9-1.el9_2.tuxcare.els30 to pick up the Go standard library
  fixes for:
- CVE-2026-78667: limit the number of ranges parsed from a Range header in
  net/http ServeContent/ServeFile/FileServer to prevent excessive CPU use
- CVE-2026-78669: make HTTP/2 SETTINGS_INITIAL_WINDOW_SIZE changes O(1) in net/http
  by tracking stream send windows as a delta against the connection initial
  window, preventing CPU exhaustion by a peer with many open streams
